sources.locator: Selected construction/control rules; exact rule locators on entries

entries.statement: The listed generic class includes COTS brushed motors and linear actuators rated for 12 V; supply uses an approved power regulating device downstream of a breaker rated no more than 20 A.
conditions: Applies only to this pinned season/manual snapshot; event applicability unresolved
20 A describes the breaker requirement, not a motor stall-current or software current-limit specification
This does not admit arbitrary brushless motors or establish controller/installation compatibility

entries.statement: Named table exemplars include NEO, NEO 550, NEO Vortex, Falcon 500, Kraken X44/X60, Minion and CIM.
conditions: Applies only to this pinned season/manual snapshot; event applicability unresolved
Examples are not exhaustive; exact manufacturer part identifiers and permitted modifications must be checked
Motor names do not provide torque, RPM, current, voltage or thermal models

entries.statement: No more than four propulsion motors; the definition concerns motion over the carpet.
conditions: Applies only to this pinned season/manual snapshot; event applicability unresolved
Steering/alignment, insignificant incidental thrust and shifting without significant propulsion are excluded
This snapshot also excludes movement via non-carpeted field-element contact
A mechanism motor contacting carpet is excluded only under the stated insignificant-thrust condition

entries.statement: R504 specifies permitted power regulating devices, including SPARK variants, Talon variants, Koors40, Thrifty Nova and Victor variants.
conditions: Applies only to this pinned season/manual snapshot; event applicability unresolved
Selected examples only, not every product from each manufacturer
Allowed device names do not establish every motor/controller pairing

entries.statement: The default is one electrical load per regulating device, subject to Table 8-2 exceptions; Falcon, Venom and Kraken motors use their integral controller category.
conditions: Applies only to this pinned season/manual snapshot; event applicability unresolved
Other brushed motors and linear actuators use the table motor-controller or relay allowance with a 20 A maximum breaker
Check every exact load class and exception before selecting a pairing

entries.statement: One main battery is a 12 V sealed lead-acid unit rated 17–18.2 Ah at the 20-hour rate.
conditions: Applies only to this pinned season/manual snapshot; event applicability unresolved
Auxiliary power exceptions have separate R602 conditions; not every secondary source is permitted
Battery eligibility is not a battery sag or capacity model
Voltage/capacity alone are insufficient; all additional R601 battery requirements apply

entries.statement: Specified PDP, PDP 2.0, PDH or AMPD distribution, main 120 A breaker, prescribed SB connectors and minimum 6 AWG main wiring are governed by R609.
conditions: Applies only to this pinned season/manual snapshot; event applicability unresolved
Read exact part identifiers, connection requirements and all branch wiring rules
This is not a complete wiring acceptance checklist

entries.statement: One roboRIO or roboRIO 2.0 with 2026_v1.2 or later image controls the robot; coprocessors may assist but device enable/disable commands originate from the roboRIO.
conditions: Applies only to this pinned season/manual snapshot; event applicability unresolved
Camera/coprocessor selection remains separate from actuator command authority

entries.statement: One event-keyed VH-109 is the specified match radio; China events use OM5P-AN/AC instead.
conditions: Applies only to this pinned season/manual snapshot; event applicability unresolved
Event region, hardware revision and current event configuration must be resolved
Do not carry another season radio exception into this snapshot

entries.statement: R703 connection topology depends on VH-109 hardware revision: v1.5 uses RIO directly or permitted pigtail/passive PoE; v1.0 requires protected RIO wiring or AUX1/AUX2 with the corresponding DIP switch off.
conditions: Applies only to this pinned season/manual snapshot; event applicability unresolved
OM5P has separate specified topology
No universal switch-between-radio-and-roboRIO recommendation is implied

entries.statement: Robot-console communication limits are 7 Mbit/s for VH-109 and 4 Mbit/s for OpenMesh, using the ports permitted in Table 8-5.
conditions: Applies only to this pinned season/manual snapshot; event applicability unresolved
These are rule ceilings, not guaranteed throughput or a complete telemetry budget
Port table and event network conditions require separate review

entries.statement: Operator signals use the arena network; permitted wireless exceptions are narrowly specified.
conditions: Applies only to this pinned season/manual snapshot; event applicability unresolved
RFID/NFC exclusively within the robot and event-provided location tags have stated exceptions
Wi-Fi/Bluetooth data links are not admitted merely because a device is a camera

entries.statement: Cameras and non-RF sensors without human-originated commands are not wireless communication devices for R707; coprocessors may assist under R701 control authority.
conditions: Applies only to this pinned season/manual snapshot; event applicability unresolved
This does not certify an entire product, RF module, laser, illuminator, wiring or power arrangement
Frames, timestamps, confidence and failure behavior remain design-contract requirements, not hardware specifications

entries.statement: The control system uses one or two required robot signal lights as specified.
conditions: Applies only to this pinned season/manual snapshot; event applicability unresolved
Exact part, wiring and placement requirements must be checked

entries.statement: Intentional interference with another robot's remote sensing is prohibited. Lasers must meet the listed Class 1 or Exempt classifications; high-intensity targeting illumination has restricted use.
conditions: Pinned TU22 snapshot only; event applicability unresolved
Do not mimic field AprilTags or assume a camera product certifies its illuminator
Review R203 classification standards, targeting-use limits and any required shrouding; device evidence is still required

unresolved: Selected rule subset, not a complete device allowance or prohibition list
Exact part/revision and complete installation require review against all applicable rules and event updates
Actual ownership, quantity, condition and team resources are not inferred
Manufacturer geometry, mounting, connectors, electrical curves, calibration and redistribution rights are separate evidence
